purpose: Reproducible initial inventory and blocker clustering, not an authority review or approval list.

selection.rule: Select explicitly mapped base priority standard types from all 814 canonical records, then exclude any baseline integration-safe rule ID. Resolve current state from cell-review.final_state, never from rules.review_state.
selection.ancillary_exclusions_are_not_irrelevant: The associated legal dependencies must still be considered in a base-rule closure; omission from this candidate denominator is not a waiver.

density_mechanism_inventory.source_mechanism: direct table dwelling-unit limit per lot
one dwelling unit per specified square feet of lot area

blocker_class_definitions.mechanical: Source attachment, row semantics, measurement-reference capture or structured expression work that may be resolved without choosing an unstated legal rule.
blocker_class_definitions.source-defect: Apparent authoritative-source error, gap or inconsistent reference; correction evidence is required before repairing its legal effect.
blocker_class_definitions.applicability: Operative version, jurisdiction, general scope or documented exception context remains to be established for the claimed display profile.
blocker_class_definitions.genuinely interpretive: The apparent defect cannot safely be given a substantive meaning from the evidence already accepted at the baseline; this is an initial question, not a final legal finding.
blocker_class_definitions.property-specific: Application requires lot, site, geography or project inputs that must remain unresolved until supported; this alone need not prevent a qualified display-safe parameter.

root_blocker_clusters.title: Operative version, Coastal profile, and general regulatory scope
root_blocker_clusters.initial_review_question: Prior closure did not authorize this family. Establish the exact outside-Coastal operative profile as of 2026-09-24; separately encode inside and unknown Coastal behavior, general overlay/supplemental scope, application-date and airport gates where a governing amendment imposes them.

root_blocker_clusters.title: Ordered compound cell is not a scalar
root_blocker_clusters.initial_review_question: Preserve source row labels, ordering, footnotes, and component meaning. Prior INTERPRETATION_REQUIRED is not proof that the source cannot be mechanically represented as a conditional expression; the separate closure review must establish that meaning.

root_blocker_clusters.title: Direct dwelling-unit limit per lot
root_blocker_clusters.initial_review_question: Retain the table mechanism of one dwelling unit per lot for RS/RX/RT. Establish legal lot and governing exception scope; do not infer density from zone digits or divide parcel area by minimum lot size.

root_blocker_clusters.title: RM density uses specified lot area per dwelling unit
root_blocker_clusters.initial_review_question: Retain square feet of lot area per dwelling unit, the 113.0222 measurement reference, and affordable-housing exception reference. A table denominator is not parcel capacity.

root_blocker_clusters.title: RM-5-12 community-plan density variant
root_blocker_clusters.initial_review_question: Footnote 36 supplies a distinct one-dwelling-unit or two-guest-room mechanism per 1,500 square feet within named community plan areas. Preserve the alternatives and leave community and use facts unresolved.

root_blocker_clusters.title: Minimum lot-area purpose and legal-lot context
root_blocker_clusters.initial_review_question: Trace the development-regulation context, table title, lot-area measurement, and legal/nonconforming-lot provisions. Do not relabel the table lot-size standard as an RM density denominator or presume it is only a subdivision restriction.

root_blocker_clusters.title: RX/RT minimum lot-area alley credit
root_blocker_clusters.initial_review_question: 131.0441 allows specified alley area toward the requirement for RX/RT lots served by alley access. Preserve the half-width, 10-foot and 10-percent bounds without deciding alley facts.

root_blocker_clusters.title: Setback measurement and supplemental requirements
root_blocker_clusters.initial_review_question: Attach governing 113.0246 measurement, lot-line and frontage context and applicable 131.0443/131.0461/131.0464 references; capture corner-resubdivision and other exceptions without treating the table parameter as parcel compliance.

root_blocker_clusters.title: RS front setback slope and cul-de-sac reductions
root_blocker_clusters.initial_review_question: Attach footnote 1 slope condition and 131.0443(a)(1) frontage condition; unknown slope and cul-de-sac facts must not select a reduced setback.

root_blocker_clusters.title: RS side and street-side width/reallocation conditions
root_blocker_clusters.initial_review_question: 131.0443(a)(4) contains undersized-width and side reallocation conditions. Preserve combined setbacks, minimum limits and established-addition requirements; property dimensions remain unresolved.

root_blocker_clusters.title: RX variable front setbacks by development size
root_blocker_clusters.initial_review_question: Development exceeding four dwelling units invokes setback distribution and approval/easement conditions; retain the 15-foot table parameter only with those dependencies.

root_blocker_clusters.title: RX attachment and adjoining-zone side conditions
root_blocker_clusters.initial_review_question: Detached and attached dwelling provisions use distinct formulas, zero-side conditions, building separation and offset conditions. Preserve alternatives without assuming structure or adjacent-zone facts.

root_blocker_clusters.title: RT front setback formula and labeled table minimum/maximum
root_blocker_clusters.initial_review_question: Retain the paired table minimum/maximum and trace the lot-depth percentage, facade and encroachment provisions; compare the RT-1-5 table maximum against governing text before selecting a bound.

root_blocker_clusters.title: RT zero-side, courtyard and adjoining-zone conditions
root_blocker_clusters.initial_review_question: The zero-side table value remains subject to lightwell/courtyard, wall, adjoining non-RT lot and opening-distance conditions.

root_blocker_clusters.title: RM setback envelope, dimensions and zone-specific conditions
root_blocker_clusters.initial_review_question: Resolve the linked RM subsection and each attached footnote; minimum/standard pairs, building-envelope percentages and dimension/height expressions retain their conditions.

root_blocker_clusters.title: RS-1-1 through RS-1-7 rear setback apparent table-reference defect
root_blocker_clusters.initial_review_question: 131.0443(a)(2)(A) cites Table 141-04D. The prior review found no authoritative repair; retain the literal citation and exclude promotion unless controlling correction resolves it. Depth and alley exceptions are separate property predicates.

root_blocker_clusters.title: Rear setback alley, depth and parking conditions
root_blocker_clusters.initial_review_question: Review exact rear-setback subsection for alley credit/reduction, lot depth, and parking access/orientation. The availability of a conditional reduction cannot be assumed.

root_blocker_clusters.title: Structure height measurement and envelope references
root_blocker_clusters.initial_review_question: Resolve 113.0270 measurement, 131.0444 envelope provisions and encroachment references; a structure-height parameter does not determine a parcel building envelope.

root_blocker_clusters.title: RS 24/30 height components and angled envelope
root_blocker_clusters.initial_review_question: Resolve each component of the 24/30 expression using 131.0444, Table 131-04H and Diagram 131-04L. Do not flatten the pair or treat it as an unqualified choice.

root_blocker_clusters.title: RT story/foundation/roof height alternatives
root_blocker_clusters.initial_review_question: Table 131-04F and 131.0444(d) distinguish story count, slab foundation versus raised floor, sloped-roof increase and front-envelope plane. Preserve all components.

root_blocker_clusters.title: Peninsula Coastal Height Limit Overlay footnote
root_blocker_clusters.initial_review_question: Footnote 37 adds a 30-foot condition in the named overlay/community context, even where the table cell is a dash. Coastal regulatory jurisdiction and Coastal Height Limit Overlay are distinct facts.

root_blocker_clusters.title: FAR measurement and governing exceptions
root_blocker_clusters.initial_review_question: Retain floor-area-ratio semantics and governing measurement/exclusion rules, not a buildable square-foot output. Attach the applicable 131.0446 subsection and footnotes.

root_blocker_clusters.title: RS Table 131-04J malformed interval and fractional gaps
root_blocker_clusters.initial_review_question: Prior review retained 4.001–5,000 and fractional-boundary/continuity defects. No source typo, rounding rule or continuous interval may be invented. Correction authority is required before promoting the referenced schedule.

root_blocker_clusters.title: RT FAR bands by story count
root_blocker_clusters.initial_review_question: Keep distinct one/two-story and three-story base ratios plus the 525-square-foot garage exclusion reference; no project story count or gross floor area is inferred.

root_blocker_clusters.title: RM FAR bands by dwelling-unit count
root_blocker_clusters.initial_review_question: Retain 1–2, 3–7 and 8-plus dwelling-unit row conditions. The dwelling-unit count is an unresolved project input, not a count computed from the density denominator.

root_blocker_clusters.title: RM-2-4 community-plan FAR variants
root_blocker_clusters.initial_review_question: Footnotes 29 and 38 give separate lower FAR parameters in the named Peninsula/Ocean Beach community areas; preserve row-specific linkage and unknown community location.

root_blocker_clusters.title: RM FAR historic-resource restriction
root_blocker_clusters.initial_review_question: Footnote 39 prevents an increase in designated historic contexts. Preserve the reference and unresolved historic status; the table number alone does not resolve the applicable prior maximum.

root_blocker_clusters.title: RM-5-12 FAR/coverage story-height schedule inconsistency
root_blocker_clusters.initial_review_question: Tables 131-04I and 131-04K move from nine stories/108 feet to more than ten stories/120 feet. Retain unresolved tenth-story and inconsistent story/height alternatives; do not fill the gap.

root_blocker_clusters.title: RS sloping-premises lot coverage
root_blocker_clusters.initial_review_question: Table reference applies in RS-1-1 through RS-1-7; 131.0445(a) supplies the 50-percent coverage rule only where more than half the premises contains steep hillsides. Geometry is unresolved.

root_blocker_clusters.title: RT coverage percentages and included/excluded building elements
root_blocker_clusters.initial_review_question: Attach 131.0445(b) garage, bay-window/turret, porch and balcony counting conditions; preserve the source percent unit and unresolved project features.

root_blocker_clusters.title: Dash is no value specified by this table cell
root_blocker_clusters.initial_review_question: A dash supplies neither zero nor unlimited development and does not establish that no governing rule exists. Review cross-references and scope before representing source absence.

131-04D:1.text: For lots where at least one-half of the front 50 feet of the lot depth has a minimum slope gradient of 25 percent, the setback closest to the street frontage may be reduced to a minimum 6 feet.

131-04G:1.text: One dwelling unit per specified square foot of lot area as determined in accordance with Section 113.0222.

131-04G:2.text: An exception to the maximum permitted density may be permitted in accordance with Chapter 14, Article 3, Division 7 (Affordable Housing Regulations).

131-04G:29.text: With the Peninsula and Ocean Beach community plan areas, the maximum floor area ratio is 0.70.

131-04G:36.text: Within the La Jolla, Pacific Beach, and Torrey Pines community plan areas, the maximum permitted density is one dwelling unit or two guest rooms for each 1,500 square feet of lot area.

131-04G:37.text: Within the Coastal Height Limit Overlay Zone in the Peninsula Community Plan area, the base zone maximum structure height shall be 30 feet, which shall be determined in accordance with Section 113.0270(a)(4)(D).

131-04G:38.text: With the Peninsula and Ocean Beach community plan areas, the maximum floor area ratio is 1.0.

131-04G:39.text: For development within a historic district or property included on the State Historic Resources Inventory, as defined in Section 5020.1 of the Public Resources Code, or within a site that is designated as a historical resource consistent with Chapter 12, Article 3, Division 2 of the San Diego Municipal Code, the maximum floor area ratio shall not increase.
